_comment: AWS-managed policies available on the deployer/CI identity for Customer 360 (Phase 20). This inventory mirrors the policies attached in the target account. These broad FullAccess policies are for the HUMAN/CI deployer identity that provisions and updates infrastructure. They MUST NOT be attached to the ECS task role the app runs under at runtime — see deploy/iam/task-role-policy.json for the least-privilege runtime role, per tasks.md 20.5.

requiredButNotSeenInScreenshot.why: Required to push the c360-api and c360-web images to ECR (tasks.md 20.2). No ECR policy was visible in the shared list — confirm it is attached or image push will fail. AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryPowerUser is sufficient if you prefer narrower push access.
Attached to the ECS task EXECUTION role (not the deployer) so Fargate can pull images and ship container logs. Provisioned by Terraform in deploy/terraform.

For the ADOT/OTel collector sidecar to write traces to X-Ray (tasks.md 20.7). Covered by the inline task-role statements in deploy/iam/task-role-policy.json; listed here as the managed-policy alternative.
For provisioning/validating the ACM certificate used by the ALB (tasks.md 20.3). ACM access was not visible in the shared list.
